_README: Hand-set expected pronunciations, in ARPAbet, highest precedence of all
reference layers. Use this for items where BEEP is wrong or contested, or
where the study is deliberately teaching one particular form.
Format:  "word": "PH ON ES"   or   "word": ["FORM ONE", "FORM TWO"]
Several forms are all ACCEPTED - scoring takes the best-matching one.
Stress digits are optional and ignored for segmental scoring.
Edit this file and restart, or call references.reload_sources().
Anything listed here should be signed off by whoever decides what the
study teaches - the pipeline will score against it without question.
